title: Fact file template
subject: History
source: Seeded from history/y4 lesson 7 (Fact file template (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 7: Muslim physicians: al-Razi and the first hospitals. To understand how Muslim physicians and hospitals advanced medicine

questions.model: Look at the al-Razi slide. He ran hospitals in two cities. Rayy and Baghdad.

questions.q: Which two diseases did al-Razi describe?
Give one way a bimaristan was like a hospital today.
questions.a: For example: wards for different illnesses or a pharmacy

questions.q: Core: Write a fact file on al-Razi: when, where, what he did. Use the portal response box or your book.
questions.a: About 854 to 925; Rayy and Baghdad; ran hospitals, wrote al-Hawi, described smallpox and measles
questions.model: Teacher shows it first: 'Name: Abu Bakr al-Razi. Lived: about 854 to 925. Place: Rayy and Baghdad.'

questions.q: Extend: Describe a bimaristan in two sentences.
questions.a: For example: It had wards for different illnesses. Rich and poor were cared for.

questions.q: Stretch: Why does writing down each patient's illness help medicine improve?
questions.a: Doctors can compare cases and learn which treatments work

questions.q: Big question: what made a good hospital 1,100 years ago?
questions.a: Separate wards, trained doctors, a pharmacy and care for rich and poor, as in the bimaristans
